ready: standing tall in first position: heels together and toes turned out in a V, arms rounded low in front of the hips (bras bas), chin up, proud posture
arm1: first position feet, arms in first position: rounded in front of the tummy as if hugging a big ball
arm2: first position feet, arms in second position: opened wide to the sides at shoulder height with soft rounded elbows
arm5: first position feet, arms in fifth position: rounded above the head like a crown
feet2: second position feet: feet apart about shoulder width with toes turned out, arms in second position
feet5: fifth position feet: feet crossed tightly with the heel of the front foot touching the toes of the back foot, arms rounded low (bras bas)
plie: demi-plie in first position: knees bent outwards over the toes, heels on the floor, back straight, arms in second position
releve: releve in first position: standing high on the balls of both feet with heels lifted, arms in fifth position above the head
tendu: tendu to the side: weight on the left leg, the right leg stretched straight out to the side with the pointed toe touching the floor, arms in second position
passe: passe (retire): standing on the straight left leg, the right foot pointed and touching the side of the left knee making a number 4 shape, arms in first position
portbras: port de bras: standing in first position, bending gracefully to the side with one arm curved over the head and the other arm low
saute: saute: jumping straight up in the air with both legs straight, toes pointed, feet off the floor, arms rounded low
pirprep: pirouette preparation: fourth position demi-plie with one foot in front of the other, knees bent, arms in first position
pirouette: pirouette: turning on the half toe of the left foot, right foot in passe at the knee, arms in first position, body slightly turned
arabesque: arabesque seen from the side: standing on the straight left leg, the right leg stretched straight behind her and lifted, one arm reaching forward and the other to the side, long elegant line, the whole body and both feet inside the frame
attitude: attitude: standing on the left leg, the right leg lifted behind with the knee bent gracefully, arms in fifth position above the head, the whole body inside the frame
reverence: reverence (ballet curtsy bow): one foot pointed behind, knees softly bent, head gently bowed with a smile, arms opened low and gracefully to the sides
final: final pose: standing on one leg with the other leg in tendu in front, one arm up in fifth position and the other in second position, big proud smile
